description: The auditable baseline shared by the Weaver, SABnzbd, and NZBGet adapters. A run artifact must include the rendered client configuration and immutable image/binary identity in addition to this contract.

common.repair: enabled when required by the fixture's declared repair profile; clean fixtures require no repair
common.completion_metric: all expected unpacked output files pass size and BLAKE3 verification
common.state: fresh client state, cache, queue, download directory, and completion directory for every run
common.scheduling: sequential randomized blocks; each fixture/transport/repetition/execution-target block contains each client exactly once
common.server_link: one transparent server-aggregate egress profile per saved plan; clients never share it in a timed run
common.wall_clock: immediately before public-API submission to client-reported terminal completion; acceptance-to-terminal retained as a secondary diagnostic; accepted only after independent output verification
common.terminal_observation: bounded by consecutive API observations at the 10ms default poll interval; the bound must be at most 1% of submission-to-terminal duration
common.cpu_time: target-specific client-process or client-container scope recorded with every result; never benchmark-controller CPU and never aggregated across mismatched scopes
common.instructions_retired: native-Linux cgroup perf for Docker when available; explicit unavailable reason for unsupported native collectors

stock.description: Co-primary profile: required NNTP, path, unpack, repair, and control settings only. SABnzbd direct_unpack is disabled; NZBGet DirectWrite and DirectUnpack are disabled; Weaver uses its normal download/extraction pipeline through its public service API.

equivalent-throughput.description: Co-primary profile: enables SABnzbd direct_unpack and NZBGet DirectWrite plus DirectUnpack. Weaver uses the same normal pipeline because it has no separate benchmark-only direct-path toggle. Every effective setting is rendered into the artifact; no fixture-specific exception is allowed.

clients.execution: production service API on a loopback listener; no benchmark-only direct path

clients.scope: only the isolated benchmark server network
clients.rationale: SABnzbd cannot currently consume the generated local CA reliably in this harness. This preserves encrypted transport throughput but is not authenticated TLS.
